messages:
Elaine: Quick announcement — we are GA-ing the VPC Edge + Network Hardening bundle for Private deployments next week. This includes BYOK KMS integration, tightened default network policies, and an opt-in FIPS compatibility toggle. Link to rollout notes: https://go/redwood/private/vpc-edge

Kevin: Rolling out with a staged ramp, starting 2026-04-01 to reduce blast radius. Docs for engineers are live: https://go/redwood/private/network-hardening. Key items for on-prem teams:
- CIDR allowlist enforcement by default
- Mutual TLS for control-plane connections
- KMS BYOK for model keys + audit log hooks

Ops-bot: Release created: vpc-edge-network-hardening-2026-04-01 (CI: #9876) :rocket:

CISO-Liaison: Compliance notes —
- FIPS mode is opt-in; customers that need FIPS can enable at deploy time.
- Audit log retention default is 90 days for GA. Extended retention (365d) will be available as an enterprise toggle.
- We are scheduling a 3rd-party pen test week of 2026-04-15.

Sophia: Customer Success heads up — do we have a clear migration plan for existing Private customers? Will any live workloads need a restart?

Kevin: Short answer: minimal restarts. Migration details:
1) Control-plane config update (no infra restart).
2) Data-plane cert rotation may require a rolling restart of nodes — typical window: 2-10 minutes per node.
3) Customers with custom network ACLs must add our new control-plane CIDRs. Example allowlist entry for most installs:

```
allowlist:
  - 10.0.0.0/16
  - 172.25.0.0/20
```

And sample CLI for cert rotation:
```
redwoodctl rotate-certs --cluster my-cluster --grace-period 120
```

Raj: What about TLS ciphers? Some regulated customers require disabling older ciphers.

Kevin: We deprecated TLS_RSA ciphers for Private last quarter — GA will enforce TLS_ECDHE_* only. If customers need a custom cipher policy, we provide a config override and will assist via SRE runbooks. See: https://go/redwood/security/tls-policies

Elaine: Action items — please ack and owners: Sales update SOW templates (Sales lead), CS to prepare customer comms (Sophia), Security to run pen test and publish report (CISO-Liaison), Eng/Oncall to monitor rollout metrics (Kevin).

Sophia: Will draft a short email for affected customers and a migration checklist. ETA: 2026-03-29.

CISO-Liaison: Scheduling note — add legal + compliance to the pen test debrief.

Elaine: Thanks everyone. Post any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:

Kevin: FYI for oncall — we'll create a dedicated dashboard for vpc-edge errors and a synthetic probe to catch control-plane handshake failures. Will ping eng-oncall when probe is live.

Raj: acked.

Ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rollout-preview @channel 2026-03-30 10:00am PT

Elaine: Closing the loop — no forced changes for customers before we announce GA. All manual steps and opt-ins will be communicated in the migration doc.
